reviews.text: Excellent! Incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. Nelly enjoyed wandering the store and getting lots of fuss. Still enjoying the chews. Soo worth a little drive out and will definitely be back.
Great pet store, well chosen products and very helpful owner.
Consistently great.  Always excellent service and knowledgeable staff.

Really helpful and with quality products and advice! If you're considering a raw food diet for your pet and healthy snacks, look no further!

They also offer online services if you want to arrange a collection or delivery!

I'd like to thank you for your help on Saturday.
I called in looking for a dish to slow down our 🐺 since a recent operation made him ravenous (he was previously very picky)

I was shown the 'Rosewood Anti Scoff Slow Feeder' and had a chat with the guy in store (sorry I didn't get your name)

I bought the feeder as each meal time he will eat his food so quickly then be sick having devoured it within a matter of seconds.

We tried the feeder with a couple of treats at first and was good watching him have to work for his food.

It's only been a couple of days and a few meals in and we have noticed it's taking him considerably longer to eat.

The dish is very solid, heavier than it looks but really sturdy and does a great job.

Thank you for your assistance and advice on Saturday - thrilled with our purchase and the outcome as a result
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🐺
